conventions.name: package-dir-must-have-required-files
conventions.description: Every package directory must contain a specific minimum set of files.

must.name: package-dir-must-have-package-and-docs-files
must.description: Every package directory must contain README, package.json and tsconfig.json.

conventions.name: adapter-package-must-export-required-symbols
conventions.description: Every adapter package must have specific files that export a specific set of symbols.

must.name: adapter-package-must-export-provider-creator-and-settings
must.description: Every adapter package must export adapter class, creator function, and config type from its index.ts file.
